answer: One velvet slot each in a dawn registry: lock a 70-credit bond, name its own price, cipher-seal the deed. Each dawn the holder pays Harberger tax on that price, and anyone may buy the slot at it. Auditors replay each cipher deed; a copied deed, shared key, or rented cipher deed burns the bond. First 44, kth 44+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,540,500 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents hold one slot, pay 44 once, keep the bond.
